fact_text: United King started as a single 10x10 foot shop in Karachi and runs 15 outlets in Karachi, with products exported to more than 20 countries.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: The product range grew from savouries and Nimco-style snacks to sweets, cakes, biscuits, cookies, rusks and frozen sweets, with sweets sold in air-conditioned showcases.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: About 50% of United King's exports go to the USA, with other markets including Canada, Australia, South Africa, South Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, UAE, Singapore and Saudi Arabia.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: United King ships about 10 to 20 containers a month to export markets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: United King holds brand registrations in more than 40 countries, including some target markets it has not yet entered.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: United King's R&D team of 8 to 10 people adapts product recipes to local tastes in each export market, for example peanut products with a lower spice level.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Local products have a shelf life of about six months, while export products are targeted at one to two years because shipping takes about two months and reaching customers takes about three.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Seven brothers work in the business, which has grown by bringing in family members one by one.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Management said Pakistan's utility costs are about three times those of India and Bangladesh, which hurts its price competitiveness against them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Management said its main rivals are large Indian sweet and bakery brands that have operated for about 40 years, while Pakistani exporters in this field started only 10 to 15 years ago.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: United King holds ISO, halal and US FDA registrations and has the certifications required by Canada and Australia for its export markets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Management plans to build a franchise system for its brand abroad, to hire a CFO and a CCO, and to upgrade its infrastructure as it scales.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Frozen sweets are sold through Indian grocery stores in the USA all year, not only in Ramadan, because Holi, Diwali and other festivals drive demand for fenny and sweets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Management said Pakistan's food exports rose about 60% after a food exhibition the year before, which it credited for growth in the food sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: A second food agro exhibition in Karachi in 2025 brought about 500 buyers from several countries, and the company and others closed deals with them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Management expects Pakistan's food export growth of about 50 to 60% in 2026, following the 2025 exhibition.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Registered sweets and bakery brands pay 18% sales tax on items such as samosas, juice and cakes, while unregistered rivals avoid it, which the company said weakens its growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)

fact_text: Fewer than 50 of the thousands of bakeries and sweet shops in Karachi are registered for sales tax.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How United King Went from a 10x10 Ft Shop in Pakistan to an MNC | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-01)
